rubric_items.reason: Built entirely on existing DoctorRepo, DoctorService, DoctorListRow types, DoctorsPage, WEEKDAYS and the existing GET /api/doctors; no new endpoint, table or migration; follows routes/services/repositories layering.
Every story S-1..S-6 is mapped to components, but as written the weekday parse (Fields.int on a string query value) would reject every chosen weekday, breaking S-2, S-3, S-4 and S-6 until fixed.
weekday and items[].weekdays have name, type, nullability, format and example; the parsing rule for the string query value is wrong, so the 400 behaviour is not exactly testable as specified.
Most choices are cited or decided by A-01..A-05, but the claim that the existing Fields integer helper parses the query weekday is stated as Known without a citation and contradicts validate.ts.
EXISTS vs JOIN, separate per-page weekdays query, with_today coupling and 1..7 link coding are each explained with their cost.
Clear story-to-component map, consistent ids and readable sections; only a small module label slip on CO-8.

findings.text: CO-3 reads weekday with Fields.int, but Fields.int rejects any non-number and req.query values are strings, so every valid weekday (e.g. "6") would fail 400 'must be a whole number'. The existing id filters parse with Number() instead.

cites.quote: reads `weekday` with the existing Fields integer helper (min 1, max 7)
if (typeof v !== 'number' || !Number.isInteger(v)) return this.fail(name, 'must be a whole number');

findings.suggested_fix: Parse weekday like departmentId (string to Number, integer and 1..7 check, f.fail('weekday', ...)) or f.oneOf('weekday', ['1'..'7']) then Number; mark the parse as Known with the validate.ts citation.

findings.text: CO-8 is filed under module sample-system:web, but it also covers doctorsRouter in api/src/routes/doctors.ts, which is in the api module.

cites.quote: The router in api/src/routes/doctors.ts passes `req.query` to the service (C8).

findings.suggested_fix: Split CO-8 into a web client component and an api router component, or note both modules.

findings.text: Q-03 (A-05) asked which parameter carries the weekday, though req.md already left it to design with a default of the existing filter keys and the stored 1..7 coding, which the migration fixes.

cites.quote: the name and coding of the weekday in the page address follow the existing filter keys and the stored weekday coding; design picks them
